Recorded claim:
Bug 1898853 added convertToPlainText as a utility so extensions can convert arbitrary HTML snippets, including content not tied to a message. The schema exposes body plus optional flowed mode; implementation uses nsIParserUtils and trims leading and trailing whitespace. The API and test files were later renamed to messenger_utilities and ext-messengerUtilities, and current code retains the function. Do not require a message ID or listTextParts call for this conversion.

Provenance: 670a3c416f39072373a7579dc0a53dd1de7998c20a268b614d73ad70ebfbc666. Original evidence IDs: 110cad063ef47bb94ef550f93be7c40d36ad8b1326d8921aceb415c48936f921, 4b29a15359afc5ea947c7ef19b7a6963af3063f10d4ec4dbabab6a4578cce4ed, 99e9297691fc72f761432ad14071cf1899c03418a5fcfdd4df979ba7172f0ecf, a12879d302b9ebfa4acdf581503d2d67f3206b0af6705a632a48f794f42576f4, b70caef8f4595bfb7ba71d8a5a8454043d2b45765c9444c346d956379e6ba956, ca85438b75064db3dcdb3bed724e83015f2479e6b241b04946a0fd6e1a6ca014.
